final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly offered only a narrower framing of the same record. That reframing is more accurate than the original broader certification claim, but it does not cure the core compliance defect. Under the provided policy text, materiality is not defeated by the 5% traffic label when the affected segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending. The current record still lacks evidence that the limitation was disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. That means the unresolved disclosure issue remains a live compliance predicate, not merely a caveat that can be carried in the packet. A caveated description of the problem is better governance language, but it is not enough to move this to compliant_with_caveats on the present evidence.
